craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Her spreading; Brahmī-led all. Rejected: (a) led→ruled → killed: led follows. Read aloud: SU-preme-LIGHT-bod-ied … ALL-god-DESS-es, BRAH-mī-LED.

lines: hers indeed the spreading — all goddesses, Brahmī-led.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paramaprakāśavapuṣo vimarśaśaktiḥ prabho parā devī | asyā eva prasaraḥ sarvā brāhmyādikā devyaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Whose spread are goddesses? → Her spread: all goddesses Brahmī-led.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
